title: Low-Sodium Uruguayan Kabanos Nimono-Simmer
description: A low-sodium twist on the traditional Uruguayan kabanos dish, featuring a silky nimono-simmer that pairs perfectly with peppery kabanos sausages.
instructions: Bring the reconstituted seaweed and water to a simmer in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced kabanos sausages and cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Add the shredded ginger and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the lemon juice and soy sauce, and cook for a final 2 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the kabanos sausages and seaweed simmer hot, garnished with additional ginger if desired.
Garnish with additional soy sauce and lemon wedges if desired.
